# Name: # OTA layout (2026-08-01). App slots are 2.5M each: the app is ~1.5 MB and the
# OTA stack (esp_http_server + mdns + app_update) adds ~0.2 MB
# ~40% headroom — a future feature must never force another cable flash of the
# partition table. storage ends exactly at the 16 MB flash top.
#   otadata 0x10000 + 0x2000 = 0x12000 -> next app rounds up to 64K = 0x20000
#   storage 0x520000 + 0xAE0000 = 0x1000000  (10.875 MB for a 7.60 MB pack)
# NOTE: the pack moved from 0x410000 to 0x520000 — esptool read_flash recipes
# that still say 0x410000 are wrong (see CLAUDE.md §6).
